svg.title: Signing has three independent tasks
svg.desc: Checking received messages uses public evidence. Approving a participant key requires an independent fingerprint comparison and is local to you. Signing outgoing messages requires your own private key, unlocked only in the tab.
svg.text: A message check, a trust decision and a signing capability.
“Do these bytes match this signing key?”
Uses public evidence. No private key or approval needed to check.
“Is this the exact key I independently compared?”
Your local approval. It grants no ability to sign as that participant.
“Use my private key for the messages I send.”
Unlock in this tab, then choose explicitly who to sign as.
You can check messages without approving keys or unlocking your own.
